messages:
maya: Quick QA catch on the Retention modal — slider thumb isn't tabbable and screen reader says 'Range' with no value. Repro: open modal -> tab -> slider skipped. sam: Repro'd. Looks like we built a custom div-based thumb; missing role="slider" and aria bindings. tabindex probably not set. andre: Also observed the focus indicator is basically invisible on dark theme. Contrast is below 3:1 for the outline. olivia: Copy nit: header currently 'Data retention' — confused with retention policy pages. Suggest 'Retention period' and tooltip 'Automatically remove user and system data after the selected time.' ben: Export mismatch: audit CSV header is 'event_time' but UI tables show 'Time (UTC)'. Analytics pipeline expects 'timestamp' (ISO8601). Can we standardize to 'timestamp'? maya: Yes please standardize to 'timestamp'. Saves mapping work for customers. sam: Plan for slider: add role="slider", aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-valuetext (e.g., '30 days'), tabindex=0, and keyboard handlers for arrow keys, page up/down. Will include unit tests. andre: For focus styling: use existing token --focus-ring and ensure high contrast (2px solid token color) on thumb. Also animate only on keyboard focus, not mouse. olivia: I'll do the copy pass: modal header, short tooltip, and localized variants (short/long) for i18n. ben: I'll open a small infra ticket for CSV header renaming: #UI-10021 and link to the audit export PR. maya: Event naming in audit logs is also inconsistent. Example: 'Key rotation requested by alice' vs 'Rotation done for key-123'. We should standardize verbs to 'initiated/completed/failed' and include actor. andrew: (typo correction) andre: I'll draft canonical event phrases and mapping table in the spec doc. prodbot: Scheduled: staging deploy with slider a11y fixes 2025-01-10T14:00:00Z. sam: Quick implementation snippet I'll push in PR: ```
``` I'll wire keyboard handlers and update aria-valuenow on input. olivia: Microcopy suggestion for KMS area: change label 'Use your KMS' -> 'Customer-managed encryption (BYOK)'. Add hint: 'Key region must match selected data region.' maya: Product asked to put Region selector above KMS toggle. Legal prefers KMS earlier for BYOK signpost. Could we reorder visually but add a small caption next to KMS like Olivia suggested? ben: Reordering is fine if we add that caption. Also add a tooltip on region selector: 'Selecting a region affects data residency and available KMS locations.' andrew: For audit CSV, I'll run a script to migrate old exports to new header name and add a version header field to avoid breaking customers. maya: Acceptance criteria draft: [1] Slider keyboard operable (tab, arrows, page up/down). [2] Screen readers read human-friendly value + unit. [3] Visible, high-contrast focus ring on thumb when focused by keyboard. [4] Modal copy updated and i18n variants provided. [5] KMS label clarified and caption linking to BYOK doc. [6] Audit CSV header standardized to 'timestamp' ISO8601 and export versioning added. sam: I'll include axe-ci checks and unit tests in the PR. olivia: I'll prepare copy strings for English short/long and a note for translators. ben: Filed #UI-10021 linking to PRs and audit infra change. andrew: I'll publish the event mapping table doc and add it to the changelog for audit consumers. maya: Assigning tasks: sam = a11y slider + tests, andre = audit event phrasing + mapping, olivia = copy + i18n notes, ben = CSV rename + infra ticket, maya = update design spec + PR checklist. I'll review combined PR before staging. :thumbsup: prodbot: Reminder: Please add changelog entries and migration notes for CSV header change. maya: Thanks all, ping me when PRs are up and I'll schedule a quick review block. :white_check_mark:
